title: Luscious Juicy Greek Lamb Gyro
description: A pungent and comforting Greek dish featuring lamb, sesame butter, and a crispy en-croute topping, all wrapped in a warm gyro bread.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sesame butter, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and coat with the sesame butter mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to the oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, slice the onion, tomato, and cucumber.
Warm the gyro bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the gyro by slicing the lamb and serving it in the warm gyro bread with the sliced onion, tomato, cucumber, and crumbly feta cheese.
